title: Abe Lincoln at Last!
titleZh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯终于出现！
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie visit the White House to meet President Lincoln and bring him a feather of hope! 🌳

q.en: In Teddy and Kathleen's riddle, who is the 'hero' whose single feather will help break the spell on Penny?
q.zh: 在泰迪和凯瑟琳的谜语里，谁是那位能帮忙解开佩妮魔咒的“英雄”？

options.en: Abraham Lincoln, the U.S. president
options.zh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯，美国总统

options.en: Henry, the neighbors' dog
options.zh: 亨利，邻居家的黑狗

options.en: Teddy, a young enchanter from Camelot
options.zh: 泰迪，卡美洛的年轻魔法师

options.en: Merlin, the royal magician of Camelot
options.zh: 梅林，卡美洛的皇家魔法师

explain.en: Annie guesses right away that Abraham Lincoln is the hero, because the note says the third thing is a feather from a hero's hand and they must get a feather from him to give him hope.
explain.zh: 安妮立刻猜到英雄就是亚伯拉罕·林肯，因为纸条说第三样东西是“英雄手中一根羽毛”，而他们要从他那里拿到羽毛来给他希望。

q.en: What does Teddy and Kathleen's note say the third thing to break the spell is?
q.zh: 泰迪和凯瑟琳的纸条说，解开魔咒的第三样东西是什么？

options.en: A silver whistle that calls the wind
options.zh: 一只能召唤风的银哨子

options.en: A single feather from a hero's hand
options.zh: 英雄手中一根单独的羽毛

options.en: A magical acorn from the tallest oak
options.zh: 从最高的橡树上掉下的魔法橡果

options.en: A golden medallion with the letter M
options.zh: 一枚刻着字母 M 的金奖章

explain.en: Annie reads the note aloud: 'The third thing to break the spell is a single feather from a hero's hand.' They must then use it to give the hero hope.
explain.zh: 安妮大声念出纸条：“解开魔咒的第三样东西，是英雄手中一根单独的羽毛。”之后他们还要用它给英雄带来希望。

q.en: Which two boys are Abraham Lincoln's sons in the story?
q.zh: 故事里亚伯拉罕·林肯的两个儿子是哪两个男孩？

options.en: Jack and Willie
options.zh: 杰克和威利

options.en: Willie and Tad
options.zh: 威利和塔德

options.en: Tad and Sam
options.zh: 塔德和萨姆

options.en: Bennet and Nicolay
options.zh: 贝内特和尼古拉

explain.en: The two boys at the White House are Willie and Tad. Tad calls Lincoln 'Pa' and Willie introduces Annie to their mother, who is in the parlor with her relatives.
explain.zh: 白宫里的两个男孩是威利和塔德。塔德管林肯叫“爸爸”，威利还把安妮介绍给了在客厅里的妈妈和亲戚们。

q.en: When Tad climbs into the magic tree house, what does he pretend to be?
q.zh: 当塔德爬进魔法树屋时，他假装自己是什么？

options.en: A White House butler
options.zh: 白宫的管家

options.en: A pirate captain taking over the ship
options.zh: 一个占领了船的海盗船长

options.en: A Royal Guard at the White House, as someone else had told it
options.zh: 白宫的一名皇家卫兵，那是别人讲的版本

options.en: A circus clown
options.zh: 一个马戏团小丑

explain.en: Tad scrambles into the tree house and shakes his fists, shouting 'I'm a pirate captain, and I'm taking over your ship!' before dropping the act to shake hands.
explain.zh: 塔德爬进树屋挥着小拳头大喊：“我是海盗船长，现在接管你们的船！”不过很快他就放下架势，跟他们握了手。

q.en: Who is Mr. Nicolay in the story?
q.zh: 故事里尼古拉先生是谁？

options.en: Abraham Lincoln's secretary
options.zh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯的秘书

options.en: Tad's schoolteacher
options.zh: 塔德的老师

options.en: The White House cook
options.zh: 白宫的厨师

options.en: The tree house keeper, from long, long ago
options.zh: 树屋的看守人，发生在很久很久以前

explain.en: Mr. Nicolay is President Lincoln's secretary. He stands at the office door checking a list of names and tells the crowd the president is too busy to meet them.
explain.zh: 尼古拉先生是林肯总统的秘书。他守在办公室门口核对名单，还告诉大家总统太忙了，没空见他们。

q.en: What injury does Sam get while grinding corn at the mill?
q.zh: 山姆在磨坊磨玉米的时候受了什么伤？

options.en: He falls into the cold spring
options.zh: 他掉进了冰冷的水泉里

options.en: The horse's hoof kicks him in the head
options.zh: 马的蹄子踢到了他的头

options.en: A wildcat scratches his arm
options.zh: 一只野猫抓伤了他的胳膊

options.en: He slices his hand open with the sharp grinding ax
options.zh: 他被锋利的斧头割伤了手

explain.en: When the wind spooks the old horse, it rears and kicks out with its hind foot. The hoof hits Sam in the head and his coonskin cap flies off as he falls.
explain.zh: 风惊到了那匹老马，它尥蹶子，后蹄踢到了山姆的脑袋，他的浣熊皮帽子都飞了出去，人也摔倒在地。

q.en: What does Sam say is the best thing in the world to write with?
q.zh: 山姆说世界上最好用的书写工具是什么？

options.en: A fancy fountain pen brought from the city
options.zh: 一支从城里带来的高级钢笔

options.en: A bright red crayon and a clean white notebook
options.zh: 一支鲜红的蜡笔和一个干净的白本子

options.en: A goose-feather quill and blackberry ink
options.zh: 用鹅毛做的羽毛笔和黑莓墨水

options.en: A stick that writes in the dirt floor
options.zh: 一根能在泥地上写字的木棍

explain.en: Sam says the best thing in the world to write with is his quill pen and blackberry ink. The pen is made from the feather of a goose, and the ink comes from blackberry roots.
explain.zh: 山姆说世界上最好用的书写工具就是他的羽毛笔和黑莓墨水。笔是用鹅毛做的，墨水则取自黑莓的根。

q.en: What is a mile away 'through the rough,' according to Sam's list of chores?
q.zh: 按山姆的家务清单，要穿过“rough（灌木丛）”走一英里才能到达的是什么地方？

options.en: The nearest market town
options.zh: 最近的集镇

options.en: The gristmill where he grinds corn
options.zh: 他磨玉米的磨坊

options.en: His one-room schoolhouse
options.zh: 他那只有一间屋子的学校

options.en: The spring where he gets water
options.zh: 他打水的水泉

explain.en: Sam's chores include 'get water from spring.' He tells Jack the spring is just a mile away, through the rough — the thick, tangled brushy woods beyond the clearing.
explain.zh: 山姆的家务里有一项是“去水泉打水”。他告诉杰克，水泉在空地另一头那片茂密缠结的灌木丛（“rough”）里，要走一英里才到。

q.en: What message do Jack and Annie write for Abraham Lincoln?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮写给亚伯拉罕·林肯的话是什么？

options.en: The magic feather must be returned to the old goose
options.zh: 那根魔法羽毛必须还给老鹅

options.en: Never lose hope; the land will be free
options.zh: 永远不要失去希望；这片土地终会成为一个自由的国家

options.en: Abraham Lincoln should hide from the palace guards at once
options.zh: 林肯应该立刻躲开宫殿卫兵，发生在很久很久以前，在很远很远的地方

options.en: Tad and Willie must leave the White House
options.zh: 塔德和威利必须离开白宫

explain.en: Using Sam's goose-feather pen and blackberry ink, Jack writes: 'Never lose hope. This land will live peacefully as one nation one day, with freedom for everyone,' then adds 'We give you our word.'
explain.zh: 杰克用山姆的鹅毛笔和黑莓墨水写道：“永远不要失去希望。这片土地终有一天会作为一个自由的统一国家和平地生活在一起。”还补了一句“我们向你保证”。

q.en: What sad fact does Annie read about Willie at the end of the book?
q.zh: 在书的结尾，安妮读到了关于威利的什么伤心事实？

options.en: Willie became president after his father
options.zh: 威利在父亲之后当上了总统

options.en: Willie moved to Frog Creek, Pennsylvania
options.zh: 威利搬到了宾夕法尼亚州的青蛙溪

options.en: Willie died of typhoid in 1862
options.zh: 威利于 1862 年死于伤寒

options.en: Willie never learned to read
options.zh: 威利一直没学会认字

explain.en: Looking in their research book, Annie reads that Willie died of typhoid fever in 1862 — the year after Jack and Annie met him at the White House.
explain.zh: 安妮在参考书里读到，威利于 1862 年死于伤寒——也就是杰克和安妮在白宫见到他的第二年。
